SideNavItemProps.name: className
SideNavItemProps.description: Extra classes for the row element.

SkeletonProps.name: variant
SkeletonProps.description: Placeholder shape: text lines (default), a rect block, or an avatar square.

SkeletonProps.name: lines
SkeletonProps.description: Number of text lines for `variant="text"` (default 1). The last of several is shorter.

SkeletonProps.name: size
SkeletonProps.description: Avatar square size: sm 32px, md 40px (default), lg 48px (control heights).

SkeletonProps.name: animated
SkeletonProps.description: Turn the pulse off (e.g. many skeletons on one screen). Reduced motion always turns it off.

SkeletonProps.name: className
SkeletonProps.description: Sizing classes. Rects need a height (e.g. `h-32 w-full`); text lines take the container width.

SliderProps.name: label
SliderProps.description: Optional visible label. When set, renders a <label> associated with the input via htmlFor/id. Prefer this or `aria-label` so the control is announced correctly by screen readers.

SpinnerProps.name: size
SpinnerProps.description: Box size: sm 12px (inline, 32px controls), md 16px (default), lg 24px (48px controls, empty states).

SpinnerProps.name: label
SpinnerProps.description: What is loading, read by screen readers and never shown (default "Loading"). Be specific when several things load at once: "Loading invoices".

SpinnerProps.name: className
SpinnerProps.description: Extra classes for the wrapper, e.g. a text color (`text-[var(--text-secondary)]`).

StatusLineProps.name: live
StatusLineProps.description: Announce changes politely (`role="status"`). Off by default to avoid chatter.

StatusLineSegmentProps.name: icon
StatusLineSegmentProps.description: 1-bit icon before the text. Use one with any non-neutral tone.

StatusLineSegmentProps.name: children
StatusLineSegmentProps.description: Segment text. Keep it to a few words.

SwitchProps.name: size
SwitchProps.description: Track size. The tap target is at least 44px tall at every size.

SwitchProps.name: label
SwitchProps.description: Visible label and accessible name. Clicking it toggles the switch. Use `hideLabel` to keep it aria-only.

SwitchProps.name: hideLabel
SwitchProps.description: Keep `label` as the accessible name only (no visible text). Use in compositions where the row already carries a visible heading — e.g. a settings row — so the name isn't duplicated next to the track.

TabsProps.name: defaultValue
TabsProps.description: Initial panel when uncontrolled; use `undefined` to auto-select the first tab.

TabsProps.name: onValueChange
TabsProps.description: Fires when the active tab changes.

TabsListProps.name: aria-label
TabsListProps.description: Accessible name for the tab strip (pass this or `aria-labelledby`).

TabsContentProps.name: forceMount
TabsContentProps.description: Keep inactive panels mounted (hidden) so form state is preserved.

TextareaProps.name: size
TextareaProps.description: Minimum height and padding: sm, md (default), lg, matching Input. Legacy names are deprecated aliases.

TextareaProps.name: error
TextareaProps.description: Error styling without a message. Prefer `errorMessage` so users learn what to fix.

TextareaProps.name: helperText
TextareaProps.description: Hint shown under the field (length, format). Linked via `aria-describedby`.

TextareaProps.name: errorMessage
TextareaProps.description: Validation message shown under the field. Sets the error state and `aria-invalid`, and replaces `helperText` while present.

TextareaProps.name: label
TextareaProps.description: Optional visible label. When set, renders a `<label>` associated with the textarea via `htmlFor` / `id`.

ToastAction.name: label
ToastAction.description: Short verb shown as the button text ("Undo", "Retry", "View").

ToastAction.name: onClick
ToastAction.description: Runs when the action is pressed; the toast dismisses itself afterwards.

ToastItem.name: id
ToastItem.description: Stable key for the toast (also used by dismissal callbacks).

ToastItem.name: message
ToastItem.description: Toast content. Keep it to one short line.

ToastItem.name: action
ToastItem.description: Optional inline action, such as Undo.

ToastItem.name: duration
ToastItem.description: Milliseconds before auto-dismiss; `Infinity` persists. Omit on controlled items to keep managing timing yourself.

ToasterProps.name: toasts
ToasterProps.description: Controlled mode: the toasts to render, oldest first (the newest renders closest to the screen edge). Omit to render the imperative `toast()` queue.

ToasterProps.name: onDismiss
ToasterProps.description: Controlled mode: called when a toast is clicked, its action runs, or its `duration` elapses. Ignored in imperative mode (the queue dismisses itself).

ToastProps.name: children
ToastProps.description: Toast content. Keep it to one short line.

ToastProps.name: onClick
ToastProps.description: Called when the plate is clicked (pointer shortcut; wire to dismiss).

ToastProps.name: action
ToastProps.description: Optional inline action button, such as Undo. Pressing it also dismisses.

ToastProps.name: duration
ToastProps.description: Auto-dismiss after this many ms, paused on hover and focus. `Infinity` persists and shows a dismiss button. Needs `onDismiss`.

ToastProps.name: onDismiss
ToastProps.description: Removes the toast (timer, action, or the dismiss button call it).

ToastOptions.name: variant
ToastOptions.description: Severity (default: "default"). The `toast.success()` style helpers set it for you.

ToastOptions.name: action
ToastOptions.description: Optional inline action, such as Undo.

ToastOptions.name: id
ToastOptions.description: Reuse an id to replace a toast in place (e.g. "Saving..." then "Saved").

ToastApi.name: error
ToastApi.description: Queues an error toast (AlertCircle, red), announced with `role="alert"`.

ToastApi.name: dismiss
ToastApi.description: Removes one toast by id, or every toast when called without one.

TooltipProps.name: content
TooltipProps.description: Short supplementary hint. Plain text; no links or buttons.

TooltipProps.name: children
TooltipProps.description: The trigger. Pass one focusable element so keyboard users can open the tooltip and hear it.

TooltipProps.name: position
TooltipProps.description: Preferred side of the trigger (default: "top"). It flips to the opposite side when this one would overflow the viewport.

TooltipProps.name: delay
TooltipProps.description: Milliseconds before showing on hover or focus (default: 200).

TooltipProps.name: maxWidth
TooltipProps.description: Max width of the balloon, any CSS length (default: "200px").

TooltipProps.name: className
TooltipProps.description: Extra classes for the wrapper (e.g. a width class for a full-width trigger).

TreeNode.name: id
TreeNode.description: Unique, stable id across the whole tree.

TreeNode.name: textValue
TreeNode.description: Plain-text label for type-ahead when `label` is not a string.

TreeNode.name: children
TreeNode.description: Child nodes. An empty array still renders a (childless) branch.

TreeNode.name: disabled
TreeNode.description: Skip this node for selection and activation (it stays focusable).

TreeViewProps.name: aria-label
TreeViewProps.description: Accessible name of the tree (pass this or `aria-labelledby`).

TreeViewProps.name: aria-labelledby
TreeViewProps.description: Id of a visible heading naming the tree.

TreeViewProps.name: defaultExpanded
TreeViewProps.description: Ids of branches open on first render (uncontrolled).

TreeViewProps.name: onExpandedChange
TreeViewProps.description: Fires with the next list of open branch ids.

TreeViewProps.name: selected
TreeViewProps.description: Selected node id (controlled). `null` for no selection.

TreeViewProps.name: onActivate
TreeViewProps.description: Fires when a node is activated with Enter or a click (open the file, go to the route).

TreeViewProps.name: className
TreeViewProps.description: Extra classes for the tree root.

TuiIconProps.name: name
TuiIconProps.description: Icon name -- must match a key in (same as the Lucide component name).

TuiIconProps.name: size
TuiIconProps.description: Box size as a Tailwind size number: "3" (12px), "4" (16px, default), "5" (20px), "6" (24px), "8" (32px).

WindowProps.name: title
WindowProps.description: Pane title shown in the title bar; also names the pane and its scroll region.

WindowProps.name: status
WindowProps.description: Short status text at the right of the title bar ("tail -f", "3 errors", "12:04").

WindowProps.name: actions
WindowProps.description: Title bar actions (icon Buttons, a Badge). Keep them small (`size="sm"`).

WindowProps.name: variant
WindowProps.description: `active` marks the focused pane (accent ring + marker); default is `default`.

WindowProps.name: titleAs
WindowProps.description: Heading element used for the title (default "h2"). Match your page outline.

WindowProps.name: scroll
WindowProps.description: Scrolling body (default true). Set false to let content size the pane.

WindowProps.name: className
WindowProps.description: Extra classes for the outer frame (set width / height here).

WindowProps.name: bodyClassName
WindowProps.description: Extra classes for the body (padding, max-height).

BoxProps.name: children
BoxProps.description: Content to sit inside the padding and on top of the background.

BoxProps.name: padding
BoxProps.description: Padding on all four sides, from the spacing scale: `none` 0, `1` 4px, `2` 8px, `3` 12px, `4` 16px, `5` 20px, `6` 24px, `8` 32px. Omit it for a flush Box.

BoxProps.name: paddingX
BoxProps.description: Left/right inset when it differs from the vertical one; replaces `padding` on that axis.

BoxProps.name: paddingY
BoxProps.description: Top/bottom inset when it differs from the horizontal one; replaces `padding` on that axis.

BoxProps.name: background
BoxProps.description: Semantic surface to paint behind the content. `card` sits on top of `container`, `container` sits on `page`; `inverse` also flips the text color so content stays readable. Omit it to stay transparent.

BoxProps.name: border
BoxProps.description: `hairline` wraps the content in the plate ring (outer stroke layer plus a 1px-inset fill layer) because `clip-path` would slice a real CSS border. A ringed Box with no `background` falls back to the `card` surface, so the ring reads as a stroke and not as a solid plate.

BoxProps.name: as
BoxProps.description: Element to render when the Box is a landmark or a list item rather than a generic grouping (`section`, `nav`, `li`, ...). Defaults to `div`.

BoxProps.name: className
BoxProps.description: Extra classes (width, height, position), merged with `cn()` so they beat the generated ones.

CenterProps.name: children
CenterProps.description: Content to center; it keeps its own layout inside the column.

CenterProps.name: maxWidth
CenterProps.description: Width of the centered column: `xs` 320px, `sm` 384px, `md` 448px (default, about the width of a sign-in card), `lg` 512px, `xl` 576px, `2xl` 672px, `none` to center a block that sizes itself.

CenterProps.name: andText
CenterProps.description: Whether to center the text as well as the box. On for empty states and splash copy; off (default) when the column holds form fields or prose, where ragged-right text is easier to read.

CenterProps.name: fullHeight
CenterProps.description: Whether to also center vertically in the viewport, for a splash, sign-in or error screen that owns the whole page. Off (default) keeps the block at the top of the flow.

CenterProps.name: as
CenterProps.description: Element to render, so a centered block can be a `section` or the page `main` instead of a `div`.

CenterProps.name: className
CenterProps.description: Extra classes (padding, background), merged with `cn()` so they win.

ContainerProps.name: children
ContainerProps.description: Page content; centered inside the max width and inset by the gutters.

ContainerProps.name: size
ContainerProps.description: Where the content stops growing: `sm` 640px, `md` 768px, `lg` 1024px (default, the reading width for most pages), `xl` 1280px, `full` no limit. The values track the breakpoint scale, so a container never straddles one.

ContainerProps.name: gutter
ContainerProps.description: Whether to inset the content from the viewport edges (20px, 40px from `lg` up). Turn it off only when a child already owns the edge, such as a full-bleed image or a nested Container.

ContainerProps.name: as
ContainerProps.description: Element to render, so the page wrapper can be the real landmark (`main`, `header`, `footer`, `nav`) instead of a `div`.

ContainerProps.name: className
ContainerProps.description: Extra classes (vertical padding, background), merged with `cn()` so they win.

GridProps.name: children
GridProps.description: Cells to place in the tracks; each child fills one cell in source order.

GridProps.name: columns
GridProps.description: Track count. Pass a number for a fixed grid, or a map such as `{ base: 1, md: 2, lg: 3 }` to change the count at a breakpoint. A map without `base` starts at one column.

GridProps.name: gap
GridProps.description: Space between all tracks, from the spacing scale: `none` 0, `1` 4px, `2` 8px, `3` 12px, `4` 16px (default), `5` 20px, `6` 24px, `8` 32px.

GridProps.name: rowGap
GridProps.description: Space between rows when it differs from `gap`, for example a tight grid with airy rows.

GridProps.name: columnGap
GridProps.description: Space between columns when it differs from `gap`.

GridProps.name: align
GridProps.description: How cells sit vertically in their row. `stretch` (default) gives every card in a row the height of the tallest one; `start` lets them keep their own height.

GridProps.name: className
GridProps.description: Extra classes (width, padding, explicit row definitions), merged with `cn()` so they win.

InlineProps.name: children
InlineProps.description: Items to place side by side; they keep their own width and wrap as a unit.

InlineProps.name: gap
InlineProps.description: Space between items, used for both the row gap and the wrap gap, from the spacing scale: `none` 0, `1` 4px, `2` 8px (default), `3` 12px, `4` 16px, `5` 20px, `6` 24px, `8` 32px.

InlineProps.name: align
InlineProps.description: How items line up across the row. `center` (default) suits controls of mixed height; `baseline` lines up the text in a label plus value meta row.

InlineProps.name: justify
InlineProps.description: How leftover horizontal space is distributed. `start` (default) keeps the cluster tight; `between` pushes the first and last item to the edges of a full-width row such as a toolbar.

InlineProps.name: wrap
InlineProps.description: Whether items flow onto a new line when the row runs out of width. Leave it on (default) so button rows and tag lists survive narrow viewports; turn it off only when overflow is handled another way.

InlineProps.name: className
InlineProps.description: Extra classes (width, padding, self-alignment), merged with `cn()` so they win.

StackProps.name: children
StackProps.description: Stack contents; laid out along `axis` with `gap` between them.

StackProps.name: gap
StackProps.description: Maps to the spacing scale (`gap-*` utilities): `none` 0, `1` 4px, `2` 8px, `3` 12px, `4` 16px (default), `5` 20px, `6` 24px, `8` 32px.

StackProps.name: className
StackProps.description: Additional CSS classes (width, padding, alignment overrides).

StackProps.name: axis
StackProps.description: Default vertical stack; horizontal for toolbars / button groups.

VisuallyHiddenProps.name: children
VisuallyHiddenProps.description: Text or markup to announce. It stays in the accessibility tree, so keep it short and literal.

VisuallyHiddenProps.name: focusable
VisuallyHiddenProps.description: Whether the content shows itself once anything inside it takes focus. Turn it on for a skip link, which must be invisible until a keyboard user tabs to it; the revealed element is statically positioned, so give it its own placement classes through `className`.

VisuallyHiddenProps.name: as
VisuallyHiddenProps.description: Element to render, when the hidden text is a `label` for a control or a `li` inside a list rather than a generic `span`.

VisuallyHiddenProps.name: className
VisuallyHiddenProps.description: Extra classes (placement for the focusable variant), merged with `cn()` so they win.
